preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 30 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with length at most 30.

postconditions.expression: all(len(substring) >= 1 for substring in [stdout]) and stdout == max((substring for substring in {A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)} if A.count(substring) > 0), key=lambda x: (A.count(x), -len(x), x), default=A)
postconditions.description: stdout is the non-empty substring of stdin that appears most frequently. If multiple substrings have the same maximum frequency, the longest one is chosen. If there is still a tie, the lexicographically latest substring is selected. If all substrings are unique, the entire string is returned.
